_doc: Per-clip label overrides for motion.py, for borderline clips the rules cannot separate without a rule fitted to one clip. Each entry: clip name -> {label, reason}. Rows are flagged "overridden": true in motion.json so the rule label stays auditable.

sword_regular_b_rec.label: transition
sword_regular_b_rec.reason: lunge recovery; hips rise 0.401, on the 0.4 fall-or-rise line

Mech_Run.label: locomotion
Mech_Run.reason: bounding run: both feet move together (gait +0.78), so the gait rule reads it as a jump
